data.name: ReceiptMustBeCompletedBeforeRouting
data.value: A GKK warehouse/location decision and its related inter-warehouse transfer cannot be created before physical goods receipt is completed.

data.name: DatDocumentSeriesRequired
data.value: An inter-warehouse transfer document series must be selected because the GKK target warehouse differs from the goods receipt warehouse.

data.name: DatDocumentSeriesInvalid
data.value: The selected inter-warehouse transfer document series is inactive, belongs to another branch, or cannot be used for inter-warehouse transfers.
